origin.autisorigins.clockwork.name: Clockwork
origin.autisorigins.clockwork.descriptio: Somebody wound these people up inside a machine-fortress and then left. The plates still turn. A Clockwork does not get hungry, and there is no breath to run out underwater, but the body does not knit the way flesh does. Food will not close a wound. Metal will: hold an ingot or a nugget and use it. Deep water rusts the plates, lightning loves them, and the gears are heavy.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_plating.des: The casing is worth two bars of armor, before you put anything else on.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_unwinding.d: You do not get hungry. Exhaustion never drains the food bar, so you do not starve and you do not have to eat.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_sealed.name: Sealed
power.autisorigins.clockwork_sealed.desc: There is no breath to lose. You do not drown, and your air does not run out underwater.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_inert.name: Inert Flesh
power.autisorigins.clockwork_inert.descr: Food and a full hunger bar do not heal you. Natural regeneration is off. Wounds close only when you ingest metal.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_ingest_ingo: Hold any ingot in the metal ingot tag and press Use to swallow it. That restores 5 hearts. Use Item is Right Mouse Button in the pack defaults. Half a second between swallows.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_ingest_nugg: Hold any nugget in the metal nugget tag and press Use to swallow it. That restores half a heart. Use Item is Right Mouse Button in the pack defaults. Half a second between swallows.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_rust.name: Rust
power.autisorigins.clockwork_rust.descri: Deep water eats the plates. While you are more than ankle-deep, you take half a heart of magic damage each second. You can still breathe. You just rust.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_gears.name: Heavy Gears
power.autisorigins.clockwork_gears.descr: The works are heavy. You move 15% slower on land.
power.autisorigins.clockwork_lightning.d: A metal body is a rod. Lightning damage is doubled.
